Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Match Area ID
Fields.Description: ID of the simple match area to which it belongs

Fields.Name: Display Mask: M00 (World Map)
Fields.Description: If enabled, sign appears on M00 map.

Fields.Name: Display Mask: M01 (Underground Map)
Fields.Description: If enabled, sign appears on M01 map.

Fields.Name: Display Mask: M10 (DLC World Map)
Fields.Description: If enabled, sign appears on M10 map.

Fields.Name: Display Zoomn Step
Fields.Description: The zoom step displayed (0-2:0 is zoomed out). This is displayed when the zoom step is greater than this.

Fields.Name: Selectable Zoomn Step
Fields.Description: Selectable zoom steps (0-2:0 is zoom out). Selection becomes available at zoom steps greater than this.

Fields.Name: Sign Sub Category ID
Fields.Description: Subcategory parameter ID (-1: Disabled). Specifies which subcategory the item belongs to. If disabled, it will not be displayed in the sign accumulation list.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Subcategory sort ID. Display order (ascending) within the same subcategory.
